title: Handmade EU Safety Tagger
oneLiner: A GPSR prep tool that helps Etsy and Shopify makers turn messy product details into EU-safe labels, responsible-person fields, and listing blockers.
targetUser: Handmade sellers, small-batch product makers, Shopify microbrands, Etsy shop owners, and export-curious creators selling physical goods into the EU without a compliance team.
keyUx: Pick a product type, paste listing copy, upload ingredient/material notes, packaging photos, supplier details, and customer warnings; the tool maps GPSR fields, flags missing Responsible Person or manufacturer data, drafts safety labels, and recommends whether each SKU can stay live in the EU.

stitchPrompt: Design a practical seller-operations product called Handmade EU Safety Tagger for handmade sellers, small-batch product makers, Shopify microbrands, Etsy shop owners, and export-curious creators preparing for EU GPSR requirements. Users pick a product type, paste listing copy, upload ingredient or material notes, packaging photos, supplier details, and customer warnings; the app maps GPSR fields, flags missing Responsible Person or manufacturer data, drafts safety labels, and recommends whether each SKU can stay live in the EU. Include a SKU intake and channel selector, GPSR field completeness checklist, Responsible Person decision card, manufacturer and material evidence shelf, safety warning label composer, EU listing block / keep matrix, and seller FAQ plus export handoff. Design direction: use a field-ops aesthetic with sturdy workbench panels, clear red/yellow/green readiness states, tactile label previews, practical mobile-friendly controls, and a craft-market-meets-compliance tone that feels useful to solo sellers under deadline pressure.
